docs.title: FellowScript
docs.text:
A Digital Scripture Community — Read · Reflect · Connect

FellowScript is a faith-based Bible study platform built to spark meaningful connections among people who seek to grow in their faith together. Users read scripture side by side, share highlights and reflections, and build one another up in the Word.

docs.title: Mission
docs.text:
Fan into flame the gift of God.

FellowScript is built to start meaningful and impactful connections with like-minded people who seek to build up their faith and fan into flame the gift of God (2 Timothy 1:6).

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text: Feature Description Digital Bible Navigate the full Bible by book and chapter with a clean reading view Highlighting Mark scripture in yellow, orange, green, pink, or blue Notes Add public or private notes to any verse Community Highlights Filter and browse other users' public highlights Group Chat Message your study group in real time Direct Messages Send private messages to individual members

docs.title: Pages
docs.text:
• Home — Introduction to FellowScript's mission and a "Start Reading" entry point
  • Bible Reader — Full digital Bible with highlighting, notes, and community tabs

docs.title: Design Philosophy
docs.text: FellowScript uses a mobile-first layout. The Bible reader replaces traditional sidebars with a bottom navigation bar (Read, Notes, Community) so everything is one thumb-tap away. The visual identity uses a dark background with a warm gold accent (#C9A84C) and editorial serif typography (Playfair Display headings, Lora body text) to give the app a reverent but modern feel.

docs.title: API Overview
docs.text: The api/ folder defines the REST endpoints that the frontend consumes. All endpoints return JSON.

docs.title: GET /api/bible/books
docs.text:
Returns a list of all available book names.

Response:

["Genesis", "Exodus", ..., "2 Timothy", ..., "Revelation"]

docs.title: GET /api/bible/{book}/{chapter}
docs.text:
Returns all verses for a given book and chapter.

Example: GET /api/bible/2 Timothy/1

Response:

{
  "book": "2 Timothy",
  "chapter": 1,
  "verses": {
    "1": "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus...",
    "2": "To Timothy, my dear son...",
    "6": "For this reason I remind you to fan into flame..."
  }
}

docs.title: GET /api/highlights/{book}/{chapter}
docs.text: Returns all highlights for a chapter. Includes the requesting user's private highlights and all public highlights.

docs.title: POST /api/highlights
docs.text:
Saves a new highlight.

Body:

{
  "book": "2 Timothy",
  "chapter": 1,
  "verse": 6,
  "color": "green",
  "visibility": "public"
}

docs.title: GET /api/notes/{book}/{chapter}?filter=all|public|mine
docs.text: Returns notes for a chapter, filtered by the filter query parameter.

docs.title: POST /api/notes
docs.text:
Saves a new note.

Body:

{
  "book": "2 Timothy",
  "chapter": 1,
  "verse": 6,
  "text": "Fan into flame — this is active. The flame is already there.",
  "visibility": "public"
}

docs.title: Messaging
docs.text: Real-time messaging (group chat and DMs) is handled via WebSocket, not REST. See Backend — messaging/websockets.py for details.

docs.title: Backend
docs.text: The backend is written in Python and is split into two domains: Bible data handling and real-time messaging.

docs.title: convertDict.py
docs.text:
Responsible for parsing the raw Bible PDF sources (ESV, NIV) in data/ and converting them into a structured Python dictionary:

# Expected output shape
{
  "2 Timothy": {
    1: {
      1: "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus...",
      2: "To Timothy, my dear son...",
      ...
    }
  }
}

This dictionary is the single source of truth for all scripture lookups.

docs.title: navigation.py
docs.text:
Handles book and chapter navigation. Given a book name and chapter number, returns the full list of verses for that chapter.

Key responsibilities: - Validate that a requested book/chapter exists - Return verse-by-verse text for display in the Bible Reader - Support search/jump by book name (used by the search bar)

docs.title: interactions.py
docs.text:
Manages all user interactions with scripture text:

Highlights - Save a highlight: { user_id, book, chapter, verse, color } - Load highlights for a chapter: returns all highlights, filtered by user or visibility

Notes - Save a note: { user_id, book, chapter, verse, text, visibility: "public" | "private" } - Load notes for a chapter: supports All / Public / Mine filters

docs.title: websockets.py
docs.text:
Runs the WebSocket server that powers real-time features:

  • Group chat — broadcasts messages to all members of a study group
  • Activity status — when a user highlights, reads, or notes a verse, their status is broadcast to the group so others can see it live (e.g. "James M. is reading verse 7")
  • Direct messages — routes private messages between two users without broadcasting to the group

docs.title: Bible Source Data
docs.text:
Located in data/:

File Translation ESV Bible.pdf English Standard Version NIV-Bible.pdf New International Version

convertDict.py parses these files on startup (or on demand) and caches the result for fast lookups.

docs.title: Data
docs.text: FellowScript's data layer handles two things: Bible source content and user-generated content (highlights, notes, messages).

docs.title: Bible Source
docs.text:
Raw Bible text is stored as PDFs in data/:

File Translation ESV Bible.pdf English Standard Version NIV-Bible.pdf New International Version

backend/bibleHandling/convertDict.py parses these into a nested dictionary structure at runtime:

Bible Dict
└── Book (e.g. "2 Timothy")
    └── Chapter (int, e.g. 1)
        └── Verse (int, e.g. 6) → text (str)

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
Each highlight record stores:

Field Type Description user_id string The user who created the highlight book string Bible book name chapter int Chapter number verse int Verse number color string yellow, orange, green, pink, or blue visibility string public or private

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
Each note record stores:

Field Type Description user_id string The author book string Bible book name chapter int Chapter number verse int Verse number text string Note content visibility string public or private created_at datetime Timestamp

docs.title: Messages
docs.text:
Each message record stores:

Field Type Description sender_id string Author group_id string Study group (null for DMs) recipient_id string DM target (null for group messages) text string Message content sent_at datetime Timestamp

docs.title: Frontend
docs.text: The frontend lives in frontend/ and is responsible for all user-facing UI. It communicates with the backend via REST API calls and a WebSocket connection.

docs.title: Home (/)
docs.text:
• Renders the landing page with the FellowScript hero, mission statement, and feature cards
  • "Start Reading" button routes the user to /reader

docs.title: Bible Reader (/reader)
docs.text:
• Fetches scripture text from the API based on selected book/chapter
  • Renders the highlight palette and applies user/community highlights inline
  • Contains the bottom tab bar (Read / Notes / Community)

docs.title: Components
docs.text: Component Description NavBar Top bar with home link, title, and overflow menu HeroSection Home page hero with title, tagline, and CTA FeatureCards 2×2 grid of feature highlights on the home page BookSearch Search bar for jumping to a book/chapter ScriptureView Renders verse-by-verse scripture with inline highlights HighlightPalette Color selector row (yellow, orange, green, pink, blue) BottomTabBar Read / Notes / Community tab switcher NotesList Notes tab — filter tabs, note cards, add-note form CommunityPanel Community tab — member list with DM buttons + group chat MemberRow Single member with avatar, name, activity status, DM button

docs.title: Styling
docs.text:
• Dark background (#1a1a2e) with gold accent (#C9A84C)
  • Fonts: Playfair Display (headings), Lora (body text)
  • Mobile-first — all layouts stack vertically; sidebars do not exist
  • Bottom tab bar replaces all sidebar navigation on mobile

docs.title: Real-Time
docs.text: The frontend maintains a WebSocket connection to backend/messaging/websockets.py: - Listens for group chat messages and renders them in the Community tab - Listens for member activity updates and refreshes the member list - Sends chat messages and outgoing DMs through the same connection

docs.title: System Architecture Overview
docs.text: FellowScript is structured as a client-server application with a Python backend, a web frontend, and real-time messaging over WebSockets.

docs.title: Folder Structure
docs.text:
FellowScript/
├── frontend/               # UI — HTML/CSS/JS (or framework TBD)
├── backend/
│   ├── bibleHandling/
│   │   ├── convertDict.py  # Converts Bible source data into a usable dict structure
│   │   ├── interactions.py # Highlight, note, and annotation logic
│   │   └── navigation.py   # Book/chapter navigation and lookup
│   └── messaging/
│       └── websockets.py   # Real-time group chat and activity broadcast
├── api/                    # API route definitions
├── data/
│   ├── ESV Bible.pdf       # ESV Bible source
│   └── NIV-Bible.pdf       # NIV Bible source
├── docs/                   # This documentation (MkDocs)
├── mkdocs.yml
└── README.md

docs.title: Data Flow
docs.text:
User Action (frontend)
        │
        ▼
   REST API (api/)
        │
        ├──▶ bibleHandling/navigation.py   → fetch book/chapter text
        ├──▶ bibleHandling/interactions.py → save/load highlights & notes
        └──▶ messaging/websockets.py       → broadcast activity & chat
        │
        ▼
   Response to frontend

docs.title: Key Modules
docs.text: Module Responsibility bibleHandling/convertDict.py Parses Bible PDFs into a structured dictionary keyed by book → chapter → verse bibleHandling/navigation.py Handles book/chapter lookup and returns verse-level text bibleHandling/interactions.py Manages highlights (color, user, verse) and notes (text, visibility, author) messaging/websockets.py WebSocket server for real-time group chat and member activity updates api/ REST endpoints consumed by the frontend frontend/ Renders the UI — home page, Bible reader, notes, community tabs

docs.title: Communication
docs.text:
• REST — Used for fetching Bible text, loading notes/highlights, and saving new ones
  • WebSocket — Used for real-time group chat messages and live member activity status

docs.title: Search Bar
docs.text:
• Sits at the top of the reader
  • Opens a book picker listing all 66 books
  • Selecting a book shows chapter numbers below
  • Selecting a chapter loads that passage

docs.title: Highlight Palette
docs.text:
• Five colors: yellow, orange, green, pink, blue
  • Tap a verse to apply the active color
  • Highlights persist per user

docs.title: Community Highlights
docs.text:
• A toggle/filter to show other users' public highlights inline
  • Each community highlight has a subtle color outline and the user's initials

docs.title: Scripture Text
docs.text:
• Clean, well-spaced serif text (Lora)
  • Verse numbers displayed inline
  • Book title and chapter heading displayed prominently

docs.title: Bottom Tab Bar
docs.text: Tab Contents Read Scripture text (default) Notes All annotations for the current chapter — see Notes Community Study group members and group chat — see Community

docs.title: Navigation
docs.text:
• ← Home in the top bar returns to the Home Page
  • Book/chapter changes stay within this screen

docs.title: Community
docs.text: The Community tab shows all members of your current study group, their reading status, and the shared group chat.

docs.title: Member List
docs.text: Each member row shows: - Online indicator — green dot (online) or grey (offline) - Color-coded avatar with initials - Display name - Activity status — what the member is currently doing (reading a verse, leaving a note, highlighting, offline) - DM button — opens a direct message thread

docs.title: Group Chat
docs.text:
• A shared message input at the bottom of the Community tab
  • All group members can read and post
  • Real-time updates via WebSocket

docs.title: Direct Messages
docs.text: Tapping DM next to a member opens a private 1-on-1 thread separate from the group chat. Messages are only visible to the two participants.

docs.title: Real-Time Behavior
docs.text: Member activity statuses (e.g. "Reading verse 7", "Left a note") update in real time so the group can see where everyone is in the scripture. This is powered by the WebSocket layer in backend/messaging/websockets.py.

docs.title: Filter Tabs
docs.text: Tab Shows All Every note on this chapter (public from group + your private notes) Public Only notes visible to the whole group Mine Only your own notes (both public and private)

docs.title: Note Card Structure
docs.text: Each note card displays: - Verse reference (e.g. 2 Tim 1:6) - Note body — the annotation text - Author avatar + name (color-coded initials) - Visibility badge — Public or Private

docs.title: Adding a Note
docs.text:
1. Tap a verse in the Read tab, or use the "Add a note on verse…" input in the Notes tab
  2. Type the note
  3. Toggle Public or Private
  4. Tap Add note to save

Public notes are immediately visible to all members of the study group.

docs.title: Design Overview
docs.text: FellowScript's UI is designed mobile-first with a dark, editorial aesthetic that feels reverent without being heavy.

docs.title: Visual Identity
docs.text:
Element Value Background Dark charcoal (#1a1a2e / near-black) Primary accent Warm gold (#C9A84C) Heading font Playfair Display (serif) Body font Lora (serif) Code font Roboto Mono

The gold accent on dark creates the parchment-and-candlelight feel of handwritten scripture — modern but grounded.

docs.title: Layout Strategy
docs.text:
On mobile, traditional sidebars are replaced entirely with a bottom navigation bar:

[ Read ]  [ Notes ]  [ Community ]

This keeps all core actions reachable with one thumb and avoids cluttered side panels on small screens.
